g.text: We go back up a level and check if the current smallest distance between query point and LDP is smaller
than the distance between x-axis of node and x-axis of query point. We find distance of x-axis of node and
x-axis ofquery point is smaller. Hence we check its remaining children .
We find that the distance between query point and the unchecked children point is lesser than current LDP point and query
point. Hence update the LDP point to unchecked children point, LDP = (-12,-3).
Now we move up to next parent node and check if current distance between query point and
LDP point is smaller than y-coordinate of query point and y-coordinate of parent node. We find
that it is larger. Hence, it can't have any unchecked children whose distance to query point will
be lesser than current least distance. So, we simply discard all the children nodes.
Again we move up and check check if current distance between query point and LDP
point is smaller than x-coordinate of query point and x-coordinate of parent node. We
find that it is larger. Hence, it can't have any unchecked children whose distance to query
point will be lesser than current least distance. So, we simply discard all the children
Hence, the final LDP found is (-12,-3)
